description: Background flight recorder that captures server warnings, errors, tracebacks, run outcomes and tool metrics for after-the-fact diagnosis. Advanced tuning (ring size, retention) lives in app-settings.json. Applies after a restart.
_note: App function, not an agent ability. Distinct from the agent-facing 'diagnostics' read ability. Its runtime is app/agent/diagnostics.py, whose recorder ANDs its enabled flag with ability_app_enabled('diagnostics_recorder') at construction. Descriptor-only by design.
